name: cava
summary: Bar spectrum audio visualizer for the terminal (also SDL). Vertical and horizontal gradients from up to 8 hex colors in an INI config; captures the default output device automatically on Windows.
configFormat: INI (config; optional theme files in a themes/ folder next to it)

install.notes: cava 1.0.0, MSI installer. Not in scoop. Seen on Windows 11 (2026-11): installs to %LOCALAPPDATA%/cava/cava.exe and does not add it to PATH; reference that full path in commandlines.

windows.notes: Per config.c: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/cava/config if set, else %USERPROFILE%\.config\cava\config; the default file is created on first launch. Audio: the README says it captures the default output device automatically, no input settings needed. How it renders in Windows Terminal was not seen.

macos.notes: README: does not render correctly in the default Terminal.app; use another terminal. Capturing system output needs a loopback device (BlackHole or Background Music via portaudio) or, on macOS 14.2+ builds with tap support, `method = coreaudio` with `source = tap`.

install.notes: Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04 to 25.10 ship 0.6.0: older than the config keys used in the recipes; check `cava -v` and the keys in your own default config.

theme.notes: [color] gradient_color_1..8 (hex) bottom to top, horizontal_gradient_color_1..8, foreground/background.

config.notes: Bars, widths, framerate, orientation, smoothing, input method; -p for a per-pane config file.
